				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h6>Our accommodation</h6>
<h2>What we offer in Tatajuba</h2>
<p><strong>It is our passion to create a sanctuary where you can relax, re-energize and reconnect with yourself and nature.</strong></p>
<p>Our mission at Tatajuba is simple: to offer a peaceful sanctuary where comfort meets the beauty of nature. Whether for a weekend getaway or a longer stay, our goal is to provide an unforgettable experience that will refresh your mind, body and soul.</div>
			</div>
			</div>
				
				
				
				
			</div>

				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h2>Discover our attractive accommodation</h2>
<p>At Tatajuba Pousada &#8211; Casa de Praia, we offer a variety of exclusive accommodations that will make your stay unforgettable. From cozy bungalows to houses on stilts over the water, each option offers a unique experience amidst the exuberant nature of Tatajuba, Brazil.</div>

				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h3>Bungalow</h3>
<p>The rooms at Bangalô Tatajuba have a king-size bed, air conditioning, a minibar, an electronic safe and a shower with hot water. There is also a private terrace with a hammock where you can sit and enjoy a beautiful view of the tropical garden.</p></div>

				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h3>Palafita</h3>
<p>Our stilts are built on a wooden frame four meters above the ground. Each has a king-size double bed, hot shower, minibar and electric safe, as well as a sofa and work desk. As you can imagine, these stilts offer incredible views. Enjoy the view of the garden and the river in the swing hammock.</p></div>

<p><span>Each kitehouse is divided into two independent rooms with a shared bathroom, electric safe and minibar. The common room is big enough for everyone and has a comfortable sofa and table for game nights. In front of each house there is a hammock with a beautiful view of the river and the garden.</span></p>
